implementation.renderer: Three.js 0.183.2 / WebGL2, PBR procedural PMREM environment, standard bloom
implementation.geometry: Beveled wedge console and metal portal frame, pivot bearings/washers/pins/hubs, 80-face brass bobs, 3D dials and glass timeline, procedural exhibition room
implementation.physics: Nonlinear damped finite-bob RK4 at 480 Hz, 120 Hz cache, deterministic 180-second replay and branch rewriting
implementation.interaction: Raycast bob click/drag, dial click/drag, timeline drag/marker jumps, semantic sliders, keyboard and touch camera controls
implementation.pickingCoordinates: snapshot().interactive array of {type,index,x,y} in viewport CSS pixels

verification.performanceScope: Only this local Chrome run using Metal GPU, desktop viewport 1440x1020; not a universal performance claim

limitations: PBR floor environment reflection, no planar instrument reflection
Soft PCF shadows approximate contact shading
Thin translucent glass without physical refraction
Exploded labels and separation are simplified; no reassembly animation
Click impulses; sideways drag sets release angle, no velocity-sensitive flick recognition
Wave timeline plots first two model channels; formation uses all fifteen
Camera distance adapts to viewport; small mobile hardware details are less readable
Impulses quantized to nearest 1/480 second; cache interpolation can smooth a discontinuity inside a sample interval
